newsitem.title: GERMANY: Changi airport installs new baggage handling system.
newsitem.headline: Changi airport installs new baggage handling system.

text.p: Changi airport in Singapore will install a new baggage handling system from May 1997, Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) said.
The airport will be the first Asian airport to install the Frankfurt airport Baggage Reconciliation System (FRA-BRS), FAG added.
Under the first installation stage, FAG Ground Handling Services will fit 41 fixed terminals and 10 radio data terminals for Singapore Airlines and its SATS ground handling subsidiary.
The FRA-BRS system, inaugurated at Frankfurt airport in 1993, is now in use at London Heathrow, London Gatwick and Manchester airports.
The system prevents check-in baggage from being loaded on to an aircraft if the corresponding passenger fails to board. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
